android.desc:
SonosTube streams videos including user local / cloud videos to Sonos speakers.

Main Features:
•  Stream video via Sonos speakers
•  Support Chromecast video streaming
•  Support video library (e.g., playlist)
•  Support video library sharing via Dropbox
•  Support playback queue
•  Support different playback orders
•  Support histories managements
•  Support dark mode
•  Support sleep timer
•  Support Sonos EQ adjustment
•  Support grouping Sonos speakers
•  Support multiple Sonos systems switch

SonosTube was built to help people enjoy high quality audio while watching video.

Please kindly let us know (support@FrontierApp.com) if you have any question, suggestion or find a bug (crashes, unable to play video, etc).
Any feedback is welcome and we will try our best to improve SonosTube!

DISCLAIMER:
•  SonosTube is not a content provider and does not host any content.
•  SonosTube does not cache any videos in your device.
